name: io.github.yugenlabsti/yugen-mt5-mcp
title: Yugen MT5 MCP
description: Secure, auditable MCP server for MetaTrader 5. Provides AI clients with controlled access to market data, account state, and trade execution through a hardened gate with allowlists, volume limits, and an append-only audit trail.

environmentVariables.name: YUGEN_MT5_ALLOWED_SYMBOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of symbols the server may read and trade (e.g. 'EURUSD,XAUUSD'), or '*' to allow every symbol. Wildcard mode prints a startup warning and does not relax any trading gate.

environmentVariables.name: YUGEN_MT5_ALLOW_LIVE_TRADING
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable order execution (open_position, place_pending_order). Defaults to 'false', which makes the server read-only regardless of account type.

environmentVariables.name: YUGEN_MT5_ALLOW_REAL_ACCOUNTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to permit operations on real (non-demo) MT5 accounts. Defaults to 'false'. Demo accounts do not need this flag.

environmentVariables.name: YUGEN_MT5_MAX_ORDER_VOLUME
environmentVariables.description: Maximum lot volume allowed in a single exposure-creating order (open_position or place_pending_order). Does not apply to closing or modifying orders. Defaults to '1.0'. Set to 'unlimited' to disable (prints a startup warning).

environmentVariables.name: YUGEN_MT5_MAX_SYMBOL_EXPOSURE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum cumulative open volume allowed across all positions in the same symbol. Checked only when opening. Defaults to '1.0'. Set to 'unlimited' to disable (prints a startup warning).

environmentVariables.name: YUGEN_MT5_AUDIT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Filesystem path for the SQLite audit database. Defaults to 'var/audit.sqlite3' relative to the working directory. Use an absolute path when running from a desktop MCP client so audit storage lands in a user-writable directory (e.g. 'C:\Users\YOUR_USERNAME\AppData\Local\Yugen\mt5-mcp\audit.sqlite3').

environmentVariables.name: YUGEN_MT5_REAL_ACCOUNT_CONSENT
environmentVariables.description: Explicit consent token required for real-account operations when YUGEN_MT5_ALLOW_REAL_ACCOUNTS is 'true'. Resets on every server restart — consent is session-scoped.

environmentVariables.name: YUGEN_MT5_REMOTE_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to start the HTTP remote transport instead of stdio. Requires the '[remote]' extra: pip install 'yugen-mt5-mcp[remote]'.

environmentVariables.name: YUGEN_MT5_REMOTE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host address the remote HTTP transport binds to. Defaults to '127.0.0.1' (loopback). Set to '0.0.0.0' for LAN/VPS use — requires TLS termination on public binds.

environmentVariables.name: YUGEN_MT5_REMOTE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the remote HTTP transport listens on. Defaults to '8765'.

environmentVariables.name: YUGEN_MT5_REMOTE_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token that remote clients must include in the Authorization header. Required when YUGEN_MT5_REMOTE_ENABLED is 'true'. Omitting this token causes startup rejection.
